## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run compile` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes

- [ ] New commands, settings, menus, and views are declared in `package.json`
      under `contributes`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] `npm run package` produces a working `.vsix`
